nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.

nodes.label: iv
nodes.title: The Questions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi).
nodes.body: GENERAL AWARENESS ABOUT CRIME, LAW AND SOCIAL ISSUES. Basic Understanding of Indian Constitution:

nodes.title: Fundamental Rights – DPSP
nodes.body: High Profile or Sensational Criminal Cases in Past and Present Scenario: Murder, Rape, Child Abuse, Human Trafficking, Corruption, Scams, Cyber Crime, Terrorism, etc.

nodes.title: Structure and Functions of Indian Criminal Justice System
nodes.body: Police/Law Enforcement, Judiciary and Prisons/Correctional System.

nodes.title: Basic Knowledge about Indian Laws
nodes.body: IPC, Cr PC and Special and Local Laws - For Examples (but not limited to), Offence against Human Body, Offence against Property, Offences against Women and Children, Offences against State, etc. FIR, Arrest and Bail Procedures in Cr PC; Basic Awareness of Juvenile Justice Act, POCSO Act, Protection of Women fromDomestic Violence Act 2005, Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013, etc. Basic Understanding of Forensic Science in Criminal Investigation.

nodes.title: Social Issues
nodes.body: Violence against Women and Children – Child Labour, Child Marriage, Dowry, Domestic Violence, Sexual Violence, Acid Attack, Caste and Communal Conflicts; Juvenile Delinquency and Youth Violence, Drug Addiction, Human Rights Violations.
